summary: Iteration 13 — Backend + Frontend E2E for seed_price + promo annotation + reset-to-seed + refactored /admin/manage. All 8 backend pytest tests PASS: seed_price present on rentals/tours/taxi, promo annotation appears when reason contains 'promo/sale/discount' AND price decreased (original_price = old_price), promo cleared when price reset to seed, non-promo reason does NOT annotate, promo-worded price INCREASE does NOT annotate. Frontend confirmed: /admin/manage 6 tabs render (tours/taxi_services/rentals/images/messages/site), PriceHistoryModal shows five promo shortcut buttons (−10/−15/−20/−25/−30 %) that auto-fill new price and 'N% off promo' reason, clicking Save creates promo → /rentals card renders struck-through original $39.00 next to sale $31.20 + orange SALE badge (data-testid='promo-badge'), Reset-to-seed button visible when current!=seed_price and PATCHes back to seed removing promo, admin CatalogPanel row also shows struck-through original + SALE tag (admin-item-promo-<id>), EditModal for rentals exposes Year/Make/Model/Color/Body/Seats fields, /tours and /taxi render normally without errors when no promos active.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: when the page first mounts on the default 'tours' tab and the user immediately clicks 'Rentals' before the initial /admin/tours fetch resolves, the late-arriving tours response overwrites the just-fetched /admin/rentals data. The Rentals tab then displays tours items (Blue Lagoon, Rose Island, etc.) until the user switches to another tab and back. Network trace confirmed: after clicking Rentals, /admin/rentals resolves first (200 → 5 rentals) then /admin/tours resolves (200 → 4 tours) and its setItems overwrites.

action_items: Fix CatalogPanel race: guard useEffect with a mounted/alive flag (or an AbortController) so late responses for a previous `kind` don't overwrite the current tab's data. Suggested fix: `useEffect(() => { let alive = true; api.get(`/admin/${kind}`).then(({data}) => { if (alive) setItems(data); }); return () => { alive = false; }; }, [kind]);`. Also consider `setItems([])` when kind changes so the user doesn't see stale items during the fetch.
critical_code_review_comments: annotate_promo() correctly requires (a) latest history reason keyword match, (b) new < old, AND (c) current price == latest new_price — this prevents a stale promo annotation after subsequent non-promo edits.
seed_db._split_seed writes `seed_price` on every startup while preserving admin-edited `price` via $setOnInsert — matches the 'Reset to seed' UX contract.
AdminManage.jsx now a clean 65-line orchestrator; refactor is well scoped. Only latent issue is the CatalogPanel race noted above.
PriceHistoryModal.applyPromo overrides the reason only if empty or matches /^\d+% off promo$/, so users don't lose custom reasons — good UX.
PromoPrice component is pure and correctly no-ops when promo?.is_promo is falsy.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — 1 HIGH ui race bug on tab switch

seed_data_creation: Mutated sentra-orange during E2E ($39 → $31.20 via -20% promo → reset back to $39). Also touched spark-compact and trax-suv during pytest and restored to seed prices. No lingering promos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend promo/seed_price + reset flow is solid across all three kinds. The one open item is the CatalogPanel useEffect race — reproducible by opening /admin/manage and clicking any non-default catalog tab within the first ~600ms. Workaround: click Images (or any non-catalog tab) then back to the intended catalog tab, or manually setItems([]) on kind change.
rca of the issue: CatalogPanel's `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [kind])` does not cancel in-flight fetches when `kind` changes. Because AdminManage default tab is 'tours', on mount an /admin/tours fetch is dispatched; clicking Rentals before that promise resolves dispatches /admin/rentals, and both promises call setItems on resolve in arbitrary order. The last-writer wins, and in practice the initial tours request lands slightly later than the second rentals request, so the tab shows tours items while the Rentals button is highlighted. Fix: capture a per-kind alive flag in the effect cleanup.
